How it works

From first call to finished upgrade

A straightforward process that keeps you informed at every step.

  1. Request a consultation

    Send the form or call us. Tell us about your property and the upgrades you are considering.

  2. Review your options

    We look at your home, explain suitable equipment and fixtures, and answer your questions.

  3. Check program fit

    We point out programs that may apply and what they typically require, before any work begins.

  4. Upgrade & follow up

    We schedule the installation, complete the work and walk you through your new equipment.

FAQ

Common questions

What upgrades does Justice Energy Co. offer?

We offer water heating upgrades (tankless, heat pump and condensing tank-type water heaters), mini-split and split-system heat pumps, water conservation fixtures, turf replacement and LED lighting retrofits.

Can you help me find rebates or incentive programs?

Yes. We work with several programs and can explain which ones may apply to your upgrade. Incentive amounts, eligibility and funding availability are set by each program and are not guaranteed.

What happens after I request a consultation?

We review your request and contact you to learn more about your property and goals. From there we discuss options, next steps and any programs that may apply.

Which areas do you serve?

We serve homeowners in Southern California. Share your property location in the consultation form and we will confirm availability.
